passages.text:
### **7.8.2. Performance Monitor Overall Counter n (** **`PMCNT` )**

_Table 68. Definition of performance monitor overall counter n register_

|Bits|Name|Read/Write|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|GRLEN-1:0|Count|RW|The counter is incremented by 1 for each performance event monitored by the performance monitor.|
||||If the performance monitor has enabled the performance monitoring count overflow interrupt, and when the highest bit of Count is 1, the interrupt is triggered. This also means that the software can cancel the interrupt by clearing the highest bit of Count to 0.|

query.intent: Find an atomic memory increment that also returns the previous value.
query.text: atomic counter increment returning previous value
